description: Take a task off the week that no longer makes sense. Only rows that have not gone live. Say why in plain words; the owner reads it. When part of a post already went out, only the channels still scheduled are cancelled and the task stays on the plan (cancelledOn says where). A slot on a later day comes off with slot_drop. It needs an act key.

id.description: The work row's id, from work_list.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

reason.description: Why it comes off, in plain words; the owner reads it.

name: work_cancel
title: Work cancel
